summary: Virgin Galactic Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 28, 2026, disclosing preliminary court approval of a settlement in consolidated stockholder derivative lawsuits. The U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of New York granted preliminary approval on May 19, 2026; a final settlement hearing is set for July 28, 2026. No financial terms, price per share, premium, or deal structure are disclosed; the filing pertains to litigation resolution rather than a corporate transaction. This is a routine disclosure of derivative litigation settlement progress, not a special situation event.
